one_card.name: One Card
one_card.description: Draw one card for a simple answer, message or piece of guidance: the main energy around your situation and what to focus on.
one_card.when_to_use: A quick message or daily guidance.
one_card.example_question: What energy should I focus on today?

positions.name: The Message
positions.meaning: The main energy around the situation, and the guidance to focus on

three_card.name: Three Cards
three_card.description: Each of the three cards stands for a different part of your situation, so you can understand it more deeply.
three_card.when_to_use: A specific question where you want clarity.

positions.name: Past
positions.meaning: What led to the situation and still shapes it

positions.name: Future
positions.meaning: Where things are heading if nothing changes

five_card.name: Five Cards
five_card.description: Five cards explore different layers of a question: what is happening, what is influencing it, and what you can do about it.
five_card.when_to_use: A deeper reading about love, career, relationships, decisions or personal growth.
five_card.example_question: Should I accept the job offer in another city?

positions.name: Hidden Obstacle
positions.meaning: What stands in the way, possibly unseen
